fact: 1911年5月21日，巴黎—马德里航空赛自巴黎西南的伊西莱穆利诺起飞，由《小巴黎人报》赞助，21架飞机报名，约30万观众到场。设计师路易-埃米尔·特兰的飞机起飞后发动机故障，转向迫降时冲入官员区，法国陆军部长贝尔托被螺旋桨碎片击中身亡，总理莫尼斯重伤；事故后大部分选手退出，仅一人完成全程。韦德里纳于5月26日抵达马德里，净飞行时间14小时55分18秒。

sources.title: 21 May–27 May 1911（This Day in Aviation）
sources.quote: The Paris–Madrid Race began at Issy-les-Moulineaux, in the southwest of Paris, France, 21 May 1911. The race was sponsored by Le Petit Parisien, a French newspaper. More than 300,000 spectators had arrived to watch the event. ... M. Henri Maurice Berteaux, France's Minister of War, was killed. Prime Minister Antoine Emmanuel Ernest Monis ... severely injured.

sources.title: 1911 Aeroplane Records（World Wide School，转 1911 年航空年鉴）
sources.quote: There were twenty-one entrants, and fully 300,000 spectators gathered to witness the initial flight of the aerial races. ... After three of the entrants had safely left the field, Aviator Train lost control of his plane, and in falling struck and killed M. Berteaux, the French Minister of War, and seriously injured Premier Monis. The accident caused the withdrawal of all but six of the original entrants, and of these but one finished. ... Vedrines net flying time, all controls and enforced stops subtracted, was 14h. 55m. 18s.

fact: 1911年6月18日，环欧飞行赛（Circuit of Europe）自巴黎附近的万塞讷起飞，全程1073英里，经列日、乌得勒支、布鲁塞尔、鲁贝、加来、伦敦再回巴黎。起飞时约70万观众到场，40余架报名，仅8架完成全程；比赛开始前后有3名飞行员死亡、3人受伤。孔诺（化名安德烈·博蒙）于7月7日完成，净飞行58小时38分。

sources.title: 1911 Aeroplane Records（World Wide School，转 1911 年航空年鉴）
sources.quote: European Circuit Race.—Started from Paris on June 18, 1911. Distance, 1,073 miles ... Three aeronauts were killed either at the start or shortly after the race was in progress. ... Seven hundred thousand spectators witnessed the start from the aviation field at Vincennes, near Paris. There were more than forty starters, of which eight finished. The winner, Lieut. Jean Conneau, who flies under the name of "Andre Beaumont," completed the circuit on July 7

fact: 1911年7月22日至26日举行环英飞行赛（Circuit of England），全程1010英里分五段，奖金5万美元（约1万英镑）；28架报名、18架起飞，17架完成第一段，5架到达爱丁堡，最终4架完成全程。同月，韦德里纳还赢得了巴黎—罗马赛与每日邮报主办的环英赛。

sources.title: 1911 Aeroplane Records（World Wide School，转 1911 年航空年鉴）
sources.quote: Circuit of England Race—1,010 Miles in Five Sections.— Start, July 22. Finish, July 26. Prize, $50,000. Twenty-eight entries and eighteen starters. Seventeen finished the first section from Brooklands to Hendon, a distance of twenty miles. Five reached Edinburgh, the second section, a distance of 343 miles, and four completed the entire circuit.

sources.title: Blériot XI（HandWiki，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: Jean Conneau (André Beaumont) In 1911 won the Paris-Rome race, the Circuit d'Europe (Tour of Europe) on 7 July and the Daily Mail Circuit of Britain Race on 26 July 1911.

fact: 1911年，在布莱里奥飞行学校学飞的价格是2000法郎；凡购买布莱里奥飞机者免费受训，其他人自1912年起降为800法郎。当时没有双操纵的教练机，训练方式是先在缩翼的「企鹅」机上练滑行，再飞短直线，最后飞航线；天赋好、天气配合的学员八天即可拿到执照，慢的要六周。取得执照须完成三次5公里以上的环形飞行，并在指定点150米范围内着陆。

sources.title: Blériot XI（HandWiki，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: Flight training was offered free to those who had bought a Blériot aircraft: for others, it initially cost 2,000 francs, this being reduced to 800 francs in 1912. A gifted pupil favoured by good weather could gain his license in as little as eight days, although for some it took as long as six weeks. There were no dual-control aircraft in these early days ... To gain a license, a pilot had to make three circular flights of more than 5 km (3 mi), landing within 150 m (490 ft) of a designated point.

sources.title: Blériot XI（owiki，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: A considerable number of pilots were trained: by 1914 nearly 1,000 pilots had gained their Aero Club de France license at the Blériot schools, around half the total number of licences issued.

fact: 1911年的法国没有由国家颁发的飞行执照制度：执照由法国航空俱乐部（Aéro-Club de France）这一民间团体颁发，各飞行学校按俱乐部标准考核。到1914年，仅布莱里奥各校就有近1000人取得该俱乐部执照，约占全部已发执照的一半。飞行员资格因此是行业自治而非国家准入。

sources.title: Blériot XI（owiki，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: A considerable number of pilots were trained: by 1914 nearly 1,000 pilots had gained their Aero Club de France license at the Blériot schools, around half the total number of licences issued.

fact: 1911年的飞行竞赛由报纸出资办成商业赛事：巴黎—马德里赛由《小巴黎人报》赞助，韦德里纳所得各项奖金合计约3万美元（当时约合10万法郎以上）；环英赛由《每日邮报》主办，奖金5万美元。奖金、门票与报纸发行量构成一个闭环：观众越多，赞助越值钱，赛事越多，飞行员越能靠奖金为生。

sources.title: 1911 Aeroplane Records（World Wide School，转 1911 年航空年鉴）
sources.quote: The various prizes to the winner aggregated $30,000. ... Circuit of England Race—1,010 Miles in Five Sections.— Start, July 22. Finish, July 26. Prize, $50,000.

sources.title: The 1911 Paris to Madrid air race（The Vintage News）
sources.quote: The winner of the race, a prominent French aviator, named Jules Vedrines, was awarded a prize of whopping 100 thousand francs.

fact: 1911年5月15日，韦德里纳驾驶布雷盖飞机，载23公斤邮件从南锡飞往吕内维尔，全程约30公里；因大风推迟一天。这次飞行不是国家邮政开办的正式航线，而是飞行员与地方推动的试验，但证明了飞机可以在两座城市之间运送信件，为后来的航空邮政提供了可演示的样本。

sources.title: First Regular Scheduled Airmail Service in France（HistoryNG）
sources.quote: On May 15, 1911, the aviation world took a sharp turn as Jules Vedrines piloted a Breguet aircraft, loaded with 23 kilograms of mail, from Nancy to Lunéville. It was not a smooth feat. Strong winds caused a day's delay, but Vedrines was undeterred. ... Vedrines completed the trip, a distance of only 30 kilometers, not because the state sanctioned it, but because the avid aviators saw a chance to prove their mettle.

fact: 布莱里奥XI型于1910年进入意大利与法国的军队服役；1911年，意大利用于北非、墨西哥方面也使用了该型机，这是重于空气的飞行器首次用于战争。该机在第一次世界大战初期被法、英、意共20个中队使用，主要执行侦察，单座型可挂载最多25公斤炸弹。

sources.title: Blériot XI（HandWiki，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: The first Blériot XIs entered military service in Italy and France in 1910, and a year later some were used by Italy in North Africa (the first use of heavier-than-air aircraft in a war) and in Mexico. ... During the early stages of World War I eight French, six British and six Italian squadrons operated various military versions of the aircraft, mainly for observation duties but also as trainers, and in the case of single-seaters as light bombers with a bomb load of up to 25 kg.

fact: 1911年法国已形成飞行学校—飞机制造—竞赛表演的产业链：布莱里奥在埃唐普、波城与伦敦亨登设校，学员多为购机者；法尔芒兄弟于1912年建飞机制造厂，至一战前共生产约1000架军用飞机。同一材料记，1911年5月21日巴黎—马德里赛起飞时，一架飞机失控撞向看台，陆军部长当场死亡、总理重伤。

sources.title: 法国第三共和国：科技创新与物质进步（今日头条，综述法国航空史）
sources.quote: 1912年,法尔芒兄弟创建飞机制造厂,至一战前,共生产大约1000架军用飞机。……1911年5月21日,巴黎和西班牙马德里联合举行航空比赛,在巴黎郊外的小机场,刚刚起飞的一架飞机突然熄火失控,然后撞向看台上的要员席,法国的陆军部长莫里斯·贝尔多(Maurice Bertaux,1852—1911)当场死亡,总理厄内斯特·莫尼斯(Ernest Monis,1846—1929)受重伤,另有大约50人也身受重伤。

sources.title: Blériot XI（owiki）
sources.quote: Louis Blériot established his first flying school at Etampes near Rouen in 1909. Another was started at Pau, where the climate made year-round flying more practical, in early 1910 and in September 1910 a third was established at Hendon Aerodrome near London.

fact: 拉泰科埃尔的航空邮政公司于1918年12月25日成立，当日由图卢兹—蒙托德朗起飞、两小时二十分后降落巴塞罗那，这是法国第一条邮政航线。公司1921至1927年以CGEA名义经营，1927年4月拉泰科埃尔把93%的股权卖给布伊卢-拉丰，后者据此成立Aéropostale；1932至1933年公司因邮政补贴丑闻解散，与多家航空公司合并组成法航。

sources.title: Aéropostale (aviation)（Wikiwand，转英文维基条目）
sources.quote: It was founded in 1918 in Toulouse, France, as Société des lignes Latécoère ... In April 1927 Latécoère ... decided to sell 93% of his business to another Brazilian-based French businessman named Marcel Bouilloux-Lafont. On that basis Bouilloux-Lafont then founded the Compagnie générale aéropostale ... The company was dissolved in 1932 and merged with a number of other aviation companies (Air Orient, Société Générale de Transport Aérien, Air Union, and Compagnie Internationale de Navigation) to create Air France.

sources.title: Permanent Exhibition: Discover the History of the Aéropostale（L'Envol des Pionniers，图卢兹航空博物馆）
sources.quote: On December 25, 1918, Pierre Georges Latécoère took off from the Toulouse-Montaudran aerodrome aboard a Salmson 2A2 and landed in Barcelona two hours and twenty minutes later. He had just created the first French postal airline.
